title: Deliver Wood to Freburg Sawmill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Wood** delivered to **Freburg Sawmill** (industry id 32, near tile 34,215).

A likely supplier is **Freburg Forest** (industry id 55, near tile 10,213); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **290 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
